analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY is in a confirmed broad downtrend (-4.0% vs SMA50, 20d slope -0.57%). This is the single most important input today — quality-value strategies suffer their worst drawdowns during market-wide selloffs, not from bad stock picks. Rule is clear: prefer cash or materially smaller sizing in this environment.

PORTFOLIO REVIEW: At 86% deployed with only $9,170 headroom remaining (gross cap 95%), the book is already near-full. Any new position would be too small (~$9k) to move the needle and would add market exposure precisely when the regime argues for less.

POSITION-BY-POSITION:
- UHS (+8.36%): Thesis intact; still on screened list with solid uptrend, basing near 52w midpoint, fwd P/E 8x. Hold. Largest position at ~20% of equity but within cap.
- ULTA (+6.05%): Consumer discretionary holding up well. Still in screened universe. Hold.
- ADSK (+4.24%): Small positive cushion, hold and monitor.
- FOXA (+1.59%): Small gain, thesis intact for media/content play. Hold.
- NXPI (-0.77%): Essentially flat; still on screened list in uptrend basing. Fwd P/E 13.76 is reasonable for a semi. Hold but watch closely — semis are macro-sensitive in a downtrend.
- AMP (-7.56%, $505.77 vs avg $547.12): THIS IS THE CONCERN. AMP does NOT appear on this cycle's screened candidate list, which strongly implies it has failed either the trend or quality filter. A -7.56% unrealized loss on a position that is now outside the investable universe is a classic thesis-break signal. The stock needs to be on watchlist for a stop-hit or manual exit if the name confirms a downtrend. At $547 entry with a ~10-12% stop, the stop level would be ~$480-$493. We are not at stop yet, but this position should be on a short leash. If AMP cannot recover above its cost basis as the market stabilizes, it should be exited.

NEW TRADES: Zero trades proposed. Rationale: (1) Confirmed market downtrend argues against adding gross long exposure. (2) Remaining headroom of only $9,170 makes meaningful position sizing impossible — any new buy would be a ~9% of equity micro-position that cannot be properly risk-managed per the 1-2% heat formula. (3) The best candidates (ISRG, DOV, NXPI already held) are legitimate quality businesses but none offer a materially asymmetric entry in a downtrending tape. (4) With a Sortino of -9.15 and profit factor of only 1.07x, capital preservation — not trade generation — is the priority. Holding the $14k cash buffer and refusing to force trades IS the edge here. Revisit when SPY reclaims SMA50 or when AMP is exited and cash is freed for a properly sized new idea.
